title: Practice 8: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: У меня много ___ (масштабный) моделей автомобилей.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «моделей»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Japan depends on foreign trade.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «торговли»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Нет ___ (единый) стандарта красоты.
exercises.prompt: There is no one standard for beauty.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «стандарта»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The Eurovision Song Contest has millions of fans around the world.
exercises.ru: У ___ конкурса «Евровидение» миллионы поклонников по всему миру.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «конкурса»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
